CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_leaderboard_from_profile()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.leaderboard
  set
    name = coalesce(nullif(new.username, ''), name),
    avatar_url = coalesce(new.avatar_url, avatar_url)
  where user_id = new.id;
  return new;
end;
$function$
